name: spectraldiffx
description: Write pseudospectral code in JAX on spectraldiffx — Fourier, Chebyshev and spherical-harmonic grids, spectral derivatives with correct dealiasing, DCT / DST transforms, Poisson and Helmholtz solvers with per-axis boundary conditions, masked-domain capacitance solves and spectral filters — instead of hand-rolling wavenumbers, FFT tricks and divide-by-k² solvers.
